subject: Observability adapter pilot coordination - Datadog + Grafana + Observify
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@datadog.com>, Samir Patel <sam@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability adapter pilot coordination - Datadog + Grafana + Observify

Hi Emma / Samir,

Thanks for taking this on — quick intro and ask from Redwood: we	want to run a small pilot to validate an adapter that lets Redwood	route telemetry (traces + metrics + select logs) to Datadog and Grafana backends via an OTLP bridge, with Observify as the system integrator. The goal is to demonstrate:

- end-to-end data fidelity (traces with attributes preserved)
- latency impact on inference requests (<10ms tail added)
- a simple marketplace listing / integration artifact for customers

Proposed scope for the pilot (2-3 weeks):
1) Tech kickoff and test plan (week 1)
2) Staging run with sample traffic and metric verification (week 2)
3) Short summary, cost/perf numbers, and draft marketplace collateral (wrap)

Attached: mutual-action-plan.docx and vendor-capability-matrix.xlsx (first drafts).

Primary Redwood leads: Naomi (technical PM), Ben (partner sales), Laura (integration PM). Can we pick a 60-minute slot for a kickoff this week? My availability: Wed 9/15 10:00-11:30 PT, Thu 9/16 13:00-16:00 PT.

Also, Emma/Samir — any pre-reqs or security questionnaires you want filled before the kickoff? We can pre-share the redwood-sow-draft.pdf and the datadog-integration-specs.pdf if helpful.

Thanks,
Naomi
--
Naomi Feldman
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0136
